title: SpiceJet Plane Tire Explodes During Landing in Bihar, 150 Passengers Safe
summary: A SpiceJet plane experienced a tire explosion during landing at Darbhanga Airport in Bihar. The pilot's quick thinking saved the lives of around 150 passengers. All passengers were safely evacuated from the aircraft.
summary_points: SpiceJet plane experiences tire explosion during landing at Darbhanga Airport
Pilot's quick thinking saves lives of around 150 passengers
All passengers safely evacuated from aircraft
Incident occurred on SpiceJet flight from Mumbai to Darbhanga
Airport authorities respond to emergency situation
